note: Attribution of every spurious signed change on the held-out split. Concept ownership comes from the reference contract's acceptable realisations; the selected realisation per pair and arm is the frozen scorer's own choice.
reading_note: Every justified change on this split is an addition, so each withdrawal any system makes is unjustified. CasePath's plan is a projection of active rules, so a branch turning on can only add documents: its zero withdrawals are a structural property of the architecture, not a measured surprise. The split therefore does not test whether a system correctly withdraws a document when a branch turns off.
